```{R}
library(tidyverse)

library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
```

```{R}
allMD<-read.table("../output/DESeq2/2023/2023-metadata-v2-fixed-filtered.txt", sep="\t", header=T, stringsAsFactors = F, quote="")

### Define disease duration using all ALS patients
patDD<-allMD[,c("ExternalSubjectId", "Subject.Group2", "Disease.Duration.in.Months")]
patDD<-patDD[!(duplicated(patDD$ExternalSubjectId)),]
patDDALS<-patDD[which(patDD$Subject.Group2=="ALS"),]

patDDALS<-patDDALS[which(patDDALS$Disease.Duration.in.Months!="Unknown"),]
patDDALS$Disease.Duration.in.Months<-as.numeric(patDDALS$Disease.Duration.in.Months)

png("../plots/DESeq2/short-long-disease/patient-DD-histogram.png", width = 8, height = 6,units = "in", res = 300)
hist(patDDALS$Disease.Duration.in.Months, breaks = 30, main="ALS Disease Duration per patient", xlab = "Disease Duration (mo)")
dev.off()

lowQtr<-quantile(patDDALS$Disease.Duration.in.Months)[2]
highQtr<-quantile(patDDALS$Disease.Duration.in.Months)[4]

patDDALS$lengthGroup<-ifelse(patDDALS$Disease.Duration.in.Months<lowQtr, "Short",
                              ifelse(patDDALS$Disease.Duration.in.Months>highQtr, "Long", "Intermediate"))

shortPats<-patDDALS$ExternalSubjectId[which(patDDALS$lengthGroup=="Short")]
intPats<-patDDALS$ExternalSubjectId[which(patDDALS$lengthGroup=="Intermediate")]
longPats<-patDDALS$ExternalSubjectId[which(patDDALS$lengthGroup=="Long")]

png("../plots/DESeq2/short-long-disease/patient-DD-histogram-v2.png", width = 6, height = 4, units = "in", res = 300)
{
  hist(patDDALS$Disease.Duration.in.Months, breaks = 30, main="ALS Disease Duration per patient", xlab = "Disease Duration (mo)")
  abline(v = lowQtr, col="red", lty=2, lwd=2)
  abline(v = highQtr, col="red", lty=2, lwd=2)
}
dev.off()

table(patDDALS$lengthGroup)

allMD$lengthGroup<-ifelse(allMD$ExternalSubjectId %in% shortPats, "Short",
                          ifelse(allMD$ExternalSubjectId %in% longPats, "Long", 
                                 ifelse(allMD$ExternalSubjectId %in% intPats, "Intermediate", NA)))

tmpDf<-as.data.frame(table(allMD$lengthGroup, allMD$Sample.group2))
tmpDf<-tmpDf[!is.na(tmpDf$Var1),]


```

### Proportions

```{R}

props<-read.table("../output/CIBERSORT/2023/Spinal/CIBERSORTx_Job96_Adjusted_2024Samples_expr0.5-rep25_TMM.txt", sep="\t", header=T, stringsAsFactors = F, quote="")
props$P.value<-props$Correlation<-props$RMSE<-NULL

#cbProps<-read.table("../output/CIBERSORT/spinal/expr0.5/CIBERSORTx_Adjusted.txt", sep="\t", header=T, stringsAsFactors = F, quote="")
#cbProps$P.value<-cbProps$Correlation<-cbProps$RMSE<-NULL

props %>%
  gather(-Mixture, key="cellType", value="proportion") %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=cellType, y = proportion, fill=cellType))+
  geom_boxplot(show.legend = F)+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=30, hjust = 1))
#ggsave("../plots/CIBERSORT/withNYGC/Spinal/Yadav-T-NK/Yadav-old-boxplot.png", width = 12, height = 6)

#table(mdSRR$sampleGroup1)

props %>% 
  gather(-Mixture, key="Celltype", value="proportion") %>% 
  inner_join(allMD, by=c("Mixture"="ExternalSampleId")) %>%
  dplyr::filter(Subject.Group2 %in% c("Control", "ALS")) %>%
  dplyr::filter(Sample.group2!="Spinal_Cord_Unspecified") %>%
  group_by(Sample.group2, Celltype) %>%
  dplyr::select(Sample.group2, Celltype, Subject.Group2, proportion) %>%
  summarise(logFC.ALS=log2(mean(proportion[Subject.Group2=="ALS"])/mean(proportion[Subject.Group2=="Control"]))) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = "Sample.group2", values_from = "logFC.ALS") %>%
  as.data.frame() -> spinal.fcs

rownames(spinal.fcs)<-spinal.fcs$Celltype
spinal.fcs$Celltype<-NULL

### Get pvalues
props %>% 
  gather(-Mixture, key="Celltype", value="proportion") %>% 
  inner_join(allMD, by=c("Mixture"="ExternalSampleId")) %>%
  dplyr::filter(Subject.Group2 %in% c("Control", "ALS")) %>%
  dplyr::filter(Sample.group2!="Spinal_Cord_Unspecified") %>%
  group_by(Sample.group2, Celltype) %>%
  dplyr::select(Sample.group2, Celltype, Subject.Group2, proportion) %>%
  summarise(p.ALS=wilcox.test(proportion[Subject.Group2=="ALS"], proportion[Subject.Group2=="Control"])$p.value) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = "Sample.group2", values_from = "p.ALS") %>%
  as.data.frame() -> spinal.p

rownames(spinal.p)<-spinal.p$Celltype
spinal.p$Celltype<-NULL

colnames(spinal.fcs)<-unlist(lapply(str_split(colnames(spinal.fcs), pattern = "_"), "[[", 3))

### CA7C1B
### e69e3f
myCol <- colorRampPalette(c('#136176', 'white', '#CA7C1B'))(100)
myBreaks <- seq(-1, 1, length.out = 100)
#myCol <- colorRampPalette(c('dodgerblue3', 'grey85', 'firebrick3'))(100)
#myBreaks <- seq(-1, 1, length.out = 100)


ctOrder<-rownames(spinal.fcs)[order(rowMeans(spinal.fcs), decreasing = T)]

#pdf("../plots/CIBERSORT/withNYGC/Spinal/Yadav-T-NK/Yadav-old-heatmap.pdf", width = 5.5, height = 6)
#png("../plots/CIBERSORT/withNYGC/Spinal/Yadav-T-NK/Yadav-old-heatmap.png", width = 5.5, height = 6, units = "in", res = 300)
ht<-Heatmap(spinal.fcs, 
            name="log2(FC) vs.\nhealthy", 
            row_order = ctOrder,
            col = colorRamp2(myBreaks, myCol), 
            rect_gp = gpar(col = "black", lwd = 1),
            column_names_rot = 30,
            column_names_centered = T, 
            cluster_columns = F,
            cluster_column_slices = F,
            cluster_rows = F, 
            row_names_side = "left",
            show_row_dend = F, 
            show_heatmap_legend = T,
            row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 16,
                                fontface = 1),
            column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 14,
                                   fontface = 1), 
            heatmap_legend_param = list(title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 14,
                                                        fontface = 2), 
                                        labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 12, fontface=1)),
            cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, w, h, fill) {
    if(spinal.p[i, j] < 0.0001) {
        grid.text("****", x, y, gp = gpar(fill = "black", col = "black", fontsize = 20))
    } else if(spinal.p[i, j] < 0.001) {
        grid.text("***", x, y, gp = gpar(fill = "black", col = "black", fontsize = 20))
    } else if(spinal.p[i, j] < 0.01) {
        grid.text("**", x, y, gp = gpar(fill = "black", col = "black", fontsize = 20))
    } else if(spinal.p[i, j] < 0.05) {
        grid.text("*", x, y, gp = gpar(fill = "black", col = "black", fontsize = 20))
    }
})
draw(ht, padding = unit(c(5, 5, 5, 5), "mm"))
#dev.off()

props %>%

  group_by(lengthGroup, Celltype) %>%

props %>%
  gather(-Mixture, key="Celltype", value="proportion") %>% 
  inner_join(cervMDALS, by=c("Mixture"="ExternalSampleId")) %>%
  group_by(lengthGroup, Celltype) %>%
  aov(proportion ~ lengthGroup, data=.) %>%
  summary
```
